name: Ruben Gallego

lean.basis: Democratic state legislator, congressman (2015–2025) and U.S. senator; once a self-described progressive, he moved toward the center in his 2024 Senate campaign.

race_2028.basis: Visited the Iowa State Fair and New Hampshire in August 2025 amid 2028 speculation, saying it was "too early" to decide; reporting in 2026 says he leaves the door open.

sources.title: Ruben Gallego and JB Pritzker among 2028 Democratic hopefuls — Deseret News
Gallego gives Democrats blunt advice in New Hampshire — Spokesman-Review (AP)

summary: Ruben Gallego, a Marine Corps veteran of the Iraq war, has been a Democratic U.S. senator from Arizona since January 2025 after ten years in the House. He won the 2024 Senate race against Republican Kari Lake by 2.4 points while Harris lost Arizona, after moving to the center from his earlier progressive profile, and has visited early primary states amid 2028 speculation.

connections.name: Kari Lake
connections.description: Gallego beat Lake in the November 2024 Arizona Senate race, winning by about 2.4 points.

connections.name: Mark Kelly
connections.description: Arizona's two Democratic senators since January 2025.

connections.name: Joe Biden
connections.description: Gallego endorsed Biden in March 2020 after his first choices, Eric Swalwell and Kamala Harris, left the race.

connections.name: Ted Cruz
connections.description: After the May 2022 Uvalde school shooting Gallego attacked Cruz on social media for opposing gun control ("you are useless").

connections.name: Kyrsten Sinema
connections.description: Gallego criticized Sinema over the filibuster and launched a Senate challenge to her in 2023; she did not seek re-election in 2024.
